work.review.noPatch: This file changed, but its patch is past what this surface renders. `git diff` in the tree has it.
work.review.none.headline: Nothing attended
work.review.none.body: Choose a session and what it changed appears here.
work.review.empty.headline: Nothing landed
work.review.empty.body: This session committed nothing to its tree, so there is no diff to read.
work.review.even.headline: Nothing beyond the line
work.review.even.body: Its tree holds nothing `{{line}}` does not, so there is no diff to read.
work.review.nothingToLand: There is nothing to land: everything its tree holds is on `{{line}}` already.
work.review.behind: `{{line}}` has {{count}} commit this work does not: it is not based on the latest `{{line}}`. Updates, on its workspace's Branches, says whether it can be brought up to date.
work.review.behind_other: `{{line}}` has {{count}} commits this work does not: it is not based on the latest `{{line}}`. Updates, on its workspace's Branches, says whether it can be brought up to date.
work.review.landsOnBranch: Accepting puts this work on a new branch, `{{branch}}`, for you to push and open a pull request from. Nothing is merged.
work.review.landsOnLine: Accepting merges this work into `{{line}}`, in the repository's own checkout.
work.review.landsOnBranchPlugin: Accepting puts this work on a new branch, `{{branch}}`, then the plugin `{{plugin}}` pushes it and opens the pull request. Nothing is merged.
work.review.landsOnStanding: Accepting adds this work to `{{branch}}`, a branch that already stands, moving it on for you to push to grow its pull request. Nothing is merged.
work.review.landsOnStandingPlugin: Accepting adds this work to `{{branch}}`, a branch that already stands, moving it on; then the plugin `{{plugin}}` pushes it to grow its pull request. Nothing is merged.
work.review.landsOwn: Accepting lands `{{branch}}`, the session's own branch, as it stands, for you to push and open a pull request from. No other branch is made, and nothing is merged.
work.review.landsOwnPlugin: Accepting lands `{{branch}}`, the session's own branch, as it stands; then the plugin `{{plugin}}` pushes it and opens the pull request. No other branch is made, and nothing is merged.
work.review.landingProblem: A press would be refused now: {{problem}}
work.review.leftOutOf: You left this part out when its line of work landed on `{{branch}}`. Discard its tree, or accept it on its own.
work.review.leavesOut: Accepting leaves out {{count}} commit the line already holds:
work.review.leavesOut_other: Accepting leaves out {{count}} commits the line already holds:
work.review.leftOut.patch: on the line as `{{commit}}`, the same change
work.review.leftOut.patchUnpaired: the same change is on the line
work.review.leftOut.empty: it became empty: its changes are already on the line
work.review.replays: It replays the {{count}} other commit onto the line.
work.review.replays_other: It replays the {{count}} other commits onto the line.
work.review.replaysMoved: The line moved since this work began: Accepting replays its {{count}} commit onto the line first.
work.review.replaysMoved_other: The line moved since this work began: Accepting replays its {{count}} commits onto the line first.
work.review.conflict: Accept would be refused now: replaying this work onto the line conflicts. {{says}}
work.review.rebaseWords: These words go to its session:
work.review.rebaseSaid: Said to its session. Accept is offered again once its tree changes.
work.review.rebaseNotSaid: Its session could not take the words now.
work.review.landingUncommitted: Accept will refuse until the {{count}} uncommitted file is committed in its tree.
work.review.landingUncommitted_other: Accept will refuse until the {{count}} uncommitted files are committed in their tree.
work.review.uncommittedTruncated: More uncommitted files than are listed here; `git status` in the tree has the rest.
work.review.uncommittedNoPatch: This file is not committed, and its patch is too large, or not text, to show here. It is in the tree.
work.review.committedNothing: This session has committed nothing yet; its work is below, not committed.
work.review.handOn: This work landed on `{{branch}}`; the plugin `{{plugin}}` can push it and open the pull request.
work.review.handProblem: A hand-off would be refused now: {{problem}}
work.review.pushHeld: Its push was held back, so no plugin was told and the branch stands. Look at its quest as it stands, then hand it off here.
work.review.pushHeldReview: Its push was held back, so no plugin was told and the branch stands. Look at its quest as it stands, then hand it off from its review.
work.review.chatPress.busy: A turn is running in this conversation; press Accept once it ends.
work.review.chatPress.elsewhere: Another window holds this conversation; press Accept there.
work.review.chatPress.moved: The work moved while it was judged; press Accept again.
work.review.chatPress.asked: A second opinion is asked on this work; press Accept again once it settles.
work.review.landed.label: where this work landed
work.review.landed.fromBranch: Its tree is gone, so the changes below are read from that branch in `{{repository}}`'s own checkout.
work.review.landed.treeStays: That branch still stands, so the work is not accepted again; its tree is still here.
work.review.landed.unreadable: Its changes could not be read from that branch: {{detail}}
work.review.landed.gone: That branch is gone from `{{repository}}` now.
work.review.landed.removed: The clean-up removed it once its work read on `{{where}}`.
work.review.landed.removedInside: The clean-up removed it inside `{{where}}`, whose work read on the line.
work.review.landed.differs: {{count}} file it changed reads otherwise on `{{where}}`: {{files}}.
work.review.landed.differs_other: {{count}} files it changed read otherwise on `{{where}}`: {{files}}.
work.review.landed.commitsGone: Git no longer holds its commits here, so whether its work reads on the line cannot be said.
work.review.landed.unknown: Git could not say whether its work reads on the line: {{detail}}
work.review.landed.notOurs: That branch no longer holds the commit the landing made it at — it was rebased or replaced — so it is not shown as this session's work.
work.review.landed.noCheckout: `{{repository}}` has no checkout on this machine, so that branch cannot be read here.
work.review.failed.headline.SESSION_NOT_: Its work is on another machine
work.review.failed.headline.SESSION_RANG: Git could not read its changes
work.review.failed.headline.TIMEOUT: The changes took too long to read
work.review.failed.headline.other: The changes could not be read
work.review.failed.next.SESSION_NOT_REVI: Review it on the machine that ran it, where its tree is.
work.review.failed.machine: Review it on {{machine}}, the machine that ran it, where its tree is.
work.review.failed.next.SESSION_TREE_GON: A landing that made a branch is read from that branch, and none is recorded here for this session. If it was merged, its work is on its repository's line; if its tree was discarded, its work went with it.
work.review.failed.next.SESSION_NO_BASE: Its timeline still lists the commits it reported, where it reported any.
work.review.failed.next.SESSION_RANGE_UN: Read again; if its tree was moved or discarded, its timeline still lists the commits it reported.
work.review.failed.next.DRIVER_NOT_READY: The review reads again by itself once the driver answers.
work.review.failed.next.TIMEOUT: It waited {{minutes}} minutes for git, which a session with many changes can take. Read again to ask once more.
work.review.failed.next.other: Read again to ask once more.
